title: Pinned Rust tool selection
responsibility: Resolves a Rust executable from the nearest declared toolchain and isolates child compilation from host compiler overrides.

inputs.name: pinnedToolchain.tool
inputs.description: Rust executable name matching /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/. It is passed to rustup as the tool to select from the channel declared by the nearest rust-toolchain.toml.

inputs.name: pinnedToolchain.options
inputs.description: Optional lookup directory, child environment, and injected runner; when supplied, run must return a ToolAnswer for the rustup lookup. Defaults to {} for options; omitted cwd, env, and run use process.cwd(), process.env, and asked, respectively.

outputs.name: pinnedToolchain
outputs.description: The selected executable path and environment for launching it. The environment inherits the chosen input environment and sets RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN, RUSTC, RUSTC_WRAPPER, RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER, PATH, and DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH for the selected toolchain; values are strings or undefined.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws Error for a tool name outside /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/, a non-directory working directory, or a filesystem or TOML failure while locating or parsing the nearest rust-toolchain.toml. It also throws if rustup cannot start, exits nonzero, or returns a blank executable path; a malformed nearer pin is not skipped in favor of an ancestor.
